title: Is every like a bookmark or every bookmark a like? I might want to bookmark an image gallery that captures the pains of Jim Crow in the United States
summary: Is every like a bookmark or every bookmark a like? I might want to bookmark an image gallery that captures the pains of Jim Crow in the United States but I DO NOT want to "like" the gallery. Might want a different word than like. Maybe a light bulb icon?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Is every like a bookmark or every bookmark a like? I might want to bookmark an image gallery that captures the pains of Jim Crow in the United States but I DO NOT want to "like" the gallery.

Might want a different word than like. Maybe a light bulb icon?
